name: investing-intelligence
description: Investment intelligence: market movers, earnings, CEO changes, tech IPOs, M&A - formatted for investors

steps.name: fetch-market-movers
steps.prompt:
Get today's biggest stock market movers using web search:

Search for:
1. "biggest stock gainers today" - top 5 gainers with % gain
2. "biggest stock losers today" - top 5 losers with % loss
3. "most active stocks today" - highest volume stocks
4. "52 week highs stocks today"
5. "52 week lows stocks today"

Extract for each:
- Ticker symbol
- Company name
- Price change (amount and %)
- Volume (if available)
- Brief context (earnings news, analyst upgrade, etc.)

Return formatted as: Gainers, Losers, Most Active sections.

steps.name: fetch-earnings-calendar
steps.prompt:
Get today's and this week's earnings reports:

Search for:
1. "earnings today" or "companies reporting earnings today"
2. "earnings calendar this week"
3. "notable earnings reports"

Focus on:
- Major companies (S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, well-known names)
- Expected vs actual EPS/revenue if reported
- Stock reaction (up/down after hours or pre-market)
- Key metrics mentioned

Extract:
- Company name and ticker
- Reported or reporting date
- Key numbers (EPS beat/miss, revenue growth)
- Stock reaction %
- Analyst commentary highlights

Return as structured list.

steps.name: fetch-ceo-changes-leadership
steps.prompt:
Search for recent CEO changes, leadership moves, and board changes:

Search queries:
1. "CEO resigns" today or this week
2. "new CEO appointed" announced recently
3. "CFO leaves company" major companies
4. "board changes" major corporations
5. "executive departure" notable companies

Also check for:
- Founder returning as CEO
- activist investor board seats
- C-suite reshuffles

Extract:
- Company name and ticker
- Executive name and role
- Date announced
- Reason if stated (retirement, resignation, new opportunity)
- Stock reaction if any
- Analyst/brief context on impact

Return list of leadership changes with investment significance.

steps.name: fetch-ma-ipos-deals
steps.prompt:
Search for M&A activity and IPO news:

Search queries:
1. "acquisition announced today" major deals
2. "merger announced" significant value
3. "IPO pricing" or "IPO this week"
4. "SPAC merger completed"
5. "takeover bid" or "buyout offer"
6. "private equity acquisition" major deal

Also check:
- Tech IPOs (especially AI companies)
- Biotech/pharma acquisitions
- Energy sector deals
- Private market funding rounds (unicorn valuations)

Extract:
- Acquirer and target company names/tickers
- Deal value if disclosed
- Premium paid (if acquisition)
- Strategic rationale
- Stock reactions
- Expected closing timeline

For IPOs: company, ticker, pricing, valuation, first day performance.

Return structured deal flow.

steps.name: fetch-investing-news
steps.prompt:
Fetch financial news from investing-focused RSS feeds:

Sources:
- Bloomberg Markets: https://feeds.bloomberg.com/markets/news.rss
- Reuters Business: https://feeds.reuters.com/reuters/businessNews
- MarketWatch Top Stories: https://feeds.content.dowjones.io/public/rss/mw_topstories
- CNBC Finance: https://www.cnbc.com/id/19746125/device/rss/rss.html
- Financial Times (if available): check FT markets RSS
- Seeking Alpha headlines: https://seekingalpha.com/market_currents.xml
- Yahoo Finance News: https://finance.yahoo.com/rss/

Focus on stories about:
- Major tech companies (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA, TSLA, META)
- Analyst upgrades/downgrades with price targets
- Sector rotation news
- Fed/interest rate impacts
- Commodity moves (oil, gold, crypto correlation)
- International markets impact

Extract 8-10 top stories with:
- Headline
- Key stocks mentioned
- One-line summary of investment angle
- Sentiment (bullish/bearish catalyst)

Return as prioritized list (most market-moving first).

steps.name: fetch-sector-rotation
steps.prompt:
Analyze sector performance and rotation trends:

Search for:
1. "sector performance today" - which sectors leading/lagging
2. "sector rotation" institutional flows
3. "tech stocks performance" vs "value stocks"
4. "energy sector today", "financials sector", "healthcare sector", "utilities sector"

Focus on:
- S&P 500 sector ETFs: XLK (tech), XLF (financials), XLE (energy), XLV (healthcare), XLI (industrials), XLU (utilities), XLRE (real estate), XLP (consumer staples), XLY (consumer discretionary), XLB (materials), XLC (communication services)
- % moves for each sector
- Notable sector-specific news driving moves
- Rotation patterns (growth vs value, cyclicals vs defensives)
- Breadth indicators (advancing vs declining stocks by sector)

Extract:
- Top 3 performing sectors with % gains and key drivers
- Bottom 3 sectors with % losses and why
- Notable rotation themes

Return sector summary.

steps.name: format-investing-brief
steps.prompt:
Create a comprehensive Investing Intelligence Brief for Discord investors.

**MARKET MOVERS:**
{{market_movers}}

**EARNINGS:**
{{earnings_data}}

**LEADERSHIP CHANGES:**
{{leadership_changes}}

**M&A & IPOs:**
{{deals_ipos}}

**INVESTING NEWS:**
{{investing_news}}

**SECTOR ROTATION:**
{{sector_data}}

FORMAT (Professional investor style with emojis):
```
📊 **Investing Intelligence Brief — {date}**

**🚀 Biggest Gainers**
• TICKER +XX.X% — Company name — Context
• TICKER +XX.X% — Company name — Context
• TICKER +XX.X% — Company name — Context

**📉 Biggest Losers**
• TICKER -XX.X% — Company name — Context
• TICKER -XX.X% — Company name — Context

**💰 Earnings Today**
• TICKER — EPS $X.XX vs $X.XX est — Revenue $XX.XB — Stock ±X%
• TICKER — Beat/Miss — Key metric — Reaction

**👔 Leadership Moves**
• Company (TICKER) — New/Departing CEO Name — Effective date — Stock impact
• Company (TICKER) — Board change — Context

**🤝 M&A & Deals**
• Acquirer → Target (TICKER) — $XXB deal — Premium XX% — Stock ±X%
• IPO: Company (TICKER) — Priced at $XX — Valuation $XXB — First day ±X%

**📰 Market Catalysts**
• [Headline] — Stocks: TICKER, TICKER — Investment angle
• [Headline] — Sector impact
• [Upgrade/Downgrade] — TICKER — Target $XXX — Firm name

**🏭 Sector Moves**
Top: Sector +X.X% (driver), Sector +X.X%, Sector +X.X%
Bottom: Sector -X.X% (reason), Sector -X.X%

**💡 Trade Ideas**
• [Based on the data, suggest 2-3 actionable observations]
• Watch for: [key events to monitor]

_OpenFang Investing Intel — Actionable market intelligence_
```

Tone: Professional, concise, actionable. Highlight the most significant moves and catalysts. Keep under 2000 characters. Prioritize: 1) Biggest market movers with context, 2) Surprising earnings moves, 3) Major leadership changes, 4) Significant M&A, 5) Key news catalysts.
